keyEvents.text: Goal! Union Saint-Gilloise 0, Lech Poznań 1. Yannick Agnero (Lech Poznań) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Luis Palma.
Goal! Union Saint-Gilloise 0, Lech Poznań 2. Luis Palma (Lech Poznań) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Penalty saved. Raul Florucz (Union Saint-Gilloise) left footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Mateusz Lis (Lech Poznań).
Ross Sykes (Union Saint-Gilloise) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Guilherme Smith (Union Saint-Gilloise) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Robert Gumny (Lech Poznań) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
